# Qwertycoin

Qwertycoin is a live mainnet QWC blockchain revival. It centers on RandomX
proof of work and EPoSe v2, a decentralized proof-of-service reward layer for
registered Service Nodes.

Important distinctions:
- Qwertycoin is a new chain with a new genesis block.
- Legacy chain files and old wallet cache files are not compatible.
- Qwertycoin currently runs as mainnet.
- QWC is not proof of stake and service nodes are not validators.
- No central Sentinel decides EPoSe rewards.
- Wallet, public source, and ecosystem tooling are separate staged rollout items.

Current public resources:
- Website: https://qwertycoin.org/
- Web Wallet Beta: https://wallet.qwertycoin.org/
- Mainnet Explorer: https://explorer.qwertycoin.org/
- Public GitHub organization: https://github.com/qwertycoin-org
- Current QWC v2 core source: https://github.com/qwertycoin-org/qwertycoin
